title: Groups
noMatchBody: Try a group's name, someone in it, or a word from the chat.

layout.title: Layout
layout.listBody: Each group with its faces and where its newest chat stopped
layout.galleryBody: Every group as a card of its members
layout.recentBody: Every group chat, newest first, with the line it stopped on

empty.title: No groups yet
empty.body: Put two or more characters in a room and see what happens.
empty.needCharacters: A group needs at least two characters. Create them first.
empty.chatsBody: Chats show up here once a group has one.

menu.deleteBody: The group and all its chats are deleted. The characters stay in your library.

create.title: New group
create.completeScene: Write the scene, or choose another option
create.discardBody: What you entered so far is lost.
create.failure: Your choices are kept. Try again.
create.partial: The group is saved. Try again to finish attaching lorebooks or opening its chat.

members.emptyBody: Create the characters first, then put them together here.
members.importBody: A chat file exported from LettuceAI, with its members

import.mapSpeaker: Choose the character for this speaker
import.body: Import this group chat and its members.

setup.name: Group name
setup.nameHint: Leave it empty to name it after who's in it.
setup.roleplayBody: A story: an opening scene and roleplay prompts.
setup.backgroundBody: Optional. Shown behind this group's chats
setup.speaker: Speaker selection
setup.beforeBody: Tap a character to choose who responds. Send delivers your message and triggers their reply.
setup.afterBody: Send only adds your message. Tap a character's avatar to make them respond instantly.
setup.orderBody: Used when everyone takes turns. Drag to change it.

speaker.llmBody: Uses your default model to choose who speaks (costs tokens)
speaker.heuristicBody: Uses participation balance and context clues (free)
speaker.directorBody: You choose which character responds to each message

memory.dynamicBody: Memories are made and recalled from the chat on their own.
memory.manualBody: You write and manage the memory notes.
memory.unavailable: Enable dynamic memory in app settings first.

scene.noneBody: The chat starts with your first message.
scene.customBody: Set where everyone is and what is happening.
scene.memberBody: Choose an opening scene from a member.
scene.noMemberScenes: None of the members has an opening scene.
scene.noneHint: Each member still speaks in their own voice. Only the opening is left to you.
scene.title: Scene

extras.body: All optional. You can change these later in the group's settings.
extras.memberLorebooksOn: Each character's lorebooks are used too
extras.memberLorebooksOff: Only the group's lorebooks are used

edit.leaveBody: Your unsaved changes to this group are lost.
edit.chatFollow: Chats that follow the group pick these up. A chat with its own setting keeps it.
edit.modeRoleplay: Add an opening scene in the Scene tab if you want one. Chats that follow the group switch too.
edit.modeRemovesScene: Saving as a conversation removes the opening scene. Chats that follow the group switch too.
edit.modeConversation: Chats that follow the group switch too. A chat with its own mode keeps it.
edit.reloadFirst: Reload to get the newer version first
edit.needTwo: A group needs at least two members
edit.lastAnswering: At least one member has to answer
edit.restoreMember: Restore {{name}} in the library, or remove them
edit.conflictBody: Your edits are kept. Reload to get the newer version with your edits on top, then save.
edit.reloaded: Reloaded. Your edits are on top of the newer version.
edit.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Your edits are kept.
edit.answersOn: The app can pick them to answer
edit.answersOff: Skipped when the app picks who answers. They answer when named.
edit.addMembersBody: They join at the end of the speaking order.
edit.everyoneHereBody: Every character in your library is in this group.
edit.membersFollow: Chats that follow the group get these members. A chat with its own members keeps them.
edit.membersLost: A character in this group was deleted. Its chats still run with who is left, but a new chat needs two members.
edit.orderArchived: Number {{number}} in the speaking order · archived

appearance.body: Applies to every chat in this group. Fields without an override follow your app appearance.
